note: Both sets cover the same core facts (2–5% contraction, 55–65% Ni / 44–55% Ti, 4–5% strain, 25–50C hysteresis, 15–30C diffuser transition) and both contain duplicated claims and slightly paraphrased 'quotes'. Set A keeps the correct mechanical force claim ('upwards of 25,000 PSI') with a matching quote, whereas Set B corrupts that fact into a fabricated 'stress upwards of 25,000 PSI' quote and adds an invented 'roughly 55 percent Titanium' composition claim. Set A's clear errors are the invented 'roughly 50 percent Nickel' claim and an invented '20,000 PSI' force claim; Set B repeats the 20,000 PSI error plus the two fabrications above. Set B does add a few correct minor items (linear actuation capability, NiTi chemical make-up) that A omits, but its extra unsupported claims outweigh that.
